svg.title: Canada Life IDP Platform — Azure architecture
svg.desc: The same single-resource-group Azure deployment as the production topology diagram (App Service web/api, Function App worker, Cosmos DB for MongoDB, Key Vault, Azure AI Foundry with Content Understanding and an optional judge agent, Container Registry) with least-privilege RBAC edges, organized against the Well-Architected Framework pillars. Monitoring/observability intentionally out of scope.
svg.text: Azure architecture, organized against the Well-Architected Framework pillars
All platform resources co-located in one Canadian region for data residency
Microsoft Entra ID — system-assigned managed identities

text.tspan: (private SMTP relay egress only, needs an EP plan)
Azure AI Foundry — Content Understanding analyzer
(disableLocalAuth: true; + optional isolated judge model & Agent Service)

svg.text: Concept diagram — generic service names only, traced 1:1 to infra/main.bicep (same content as canada-life-idp-azure-production-topology.md). Dashed boxes/edges denote optional or conditional components. Official Microsoft Azure Architecture Center icons.
